info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Amazon API Gateway 2014 11 13 Dependency-Graph API
APIs.io Engineering Platform Get a diff of the dependencies between commits

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: basehead
params.description: The base and head Git revisions to compare. The Git revisions will be resolved to commit SHAs. Named revisions will be resolved to their corresponding HEAD commits, and an appropriate merge base will be determined. This parameter expects the format `{base}...{head}`.

params.name: name
params.description: The full path, relative to the repository root, of the dependency manifest file.

items.docs: Gets the diff of the dependency changes between two commits of a repository, based on the changes to the dependency manifests made in those commits.

info.name: APIs.io Engineering Platform Create a snapshot of dependencies for a repository

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs:
Create a new snapshot of a repository's dependencies.

The authenticated user must have access to the repository.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
